**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

  > Re-pass (2026-09-17): SATISFIED — FR-011 now states the spawn-a-new-unit rule verbatim.
- [x] CHK003 - Are skill-rule requirements present for every FR-001–FR-009 domain with no domain left to implementer discretion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-009]
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for areas that cannot be completed in-session, including the follow-up record format? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
  > Reviewer (2026-09-17): SATISFIED via Spec Assumptions ("recorded as an explicit follow-up") plus the `follow-ups` / `residual findings` fields in contracts/verification-record.md.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 - Can SC-001's "within 5 minutes" reviewer test be objectively administered (who is tested, on which change sample)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

  > Re-pass (2026-09-17): SATISFIED — SC-001 now specifies tester (uninvolved reviewer), sample (random 3 units), and timing (5 minutes per unit).
- [x] CHK013 - Are SC-002's "zero new warnings / zero regressions" deltas defined against a recorded-baseline mechanism in requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

- [x] CHK014 - Is SC-005's trial-task measurement specified (task selection, success threshold, who records the result)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

- [x] CHK015 - Are the guidance-schema acceptance checks traceable to FR-015 and SC-005 with no orphaned criteria? [Traceability, Plan §contracts]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK016 - Are requirements defined for the constitution-conflict scenario, including detection, surfacing format, and who adjudicates? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-010]
  > Reviewer (2026-09-17): NOT SATISFIED — FR-010 mandates "surfaced explicitly" but names no surfacing location. Adjudication is settled (constitution wins, no adjudicator needed). Fix: point surfacing at the Verification Record `skills applied` deviation field.
  > Re-pass (2026-09-17): SATISFIED — FR-010 now points surfacing at the Verification Record deviation field.
- [x] CHK017 - Are requirements defined for deliberate-divergence documentation (unsafe, perf, sidecar), including the required content of the reason record? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 - Are rollback/recovery requirements defined for a unit whose verification fails after edits (baseline-restore procedure)? [Gap, Recovery]
  > Reviewer (2026-09-17): NOT SATISFIED — nothing in spec, plan, or contracts states how a failed unit is unwound (revert-to-baseline vs fix-forward). Fix: add a one-line rollback rule to FR-011 or FR-013.
  > Re-pass (2026-09-17): SATISFIED — FR-013 now requires return-to-baseline or bring-to-green within the same unit, with no persisting unverifiable state.

- **Findings requiring author action**: CHK002 (fallout rule into FR-011), CHK008 (guard list into FR-012), CHK012 (SC-001 administration), CHK016 (conflict surfacing location), CHK018 (rollback rule), CHK019 (parity in requirements — highest priority, constitution Principle II is NON-NEGOTIABLE), CHK020 (throughput bar in requirements), CHK023 ("sequencing only" clarifier).
- **Suggested author loop**: apply the 8 one-line fixes to spec.md (and the verification-record contract for CHK012/CHK016), then ask the reviewer for a re-pass over the 8 items before `/speckit.tasks`.
- **Re-pass result (2026-09-17)**: all 8 fixes verified in spec.md — FR-010 (deviation field), FR-011 (fallout rule), FR-012 (guard list), FR-013 (rollback rule), SC-001 (administration), SC-002 (throughput bar), SC-004 (parity observable), Assumptions (sequencing clarifier). Checklist is now **24/24 satisfied**; no contract changes were needed (both CHK012/CHK016 alternatives were satisfied directly in requirements). Cleared for `/speckit.tasks`.
